blocks.heading: What a Missing Degree Closes
rows: Government and public-sector notices
Many posts state graduation as the minimum qualification, so a missing degree can block them.
Read the notice line. Posts at Class 10 or 12 level may be open.
Licensed professions
Medicine, law, teaching and similar fields need specific degrees and registration.
Complete the degree through the route that regulators accept.
Campus placement
Companies that recruit on campus usually ask for a degree and clear backlogs.
Apply through skills-based hiring, referrals and direct applications.
Skill-led work
Software, design, sales, operations, content and trades hire on proof of work in many firms.
Build a portfolio and a referral network.

visuals.heading: Money: Do Not Let Sunk Cost Decide

blocks.heading: Money: Do Not Let Sunk Cost Decide

figures.label: Education Budget Example
figures.source: Our strongest suggestion: keep any new degree or course fee near a tenth of the family's total education budget, and treat spending above roughly a fifth as a serious caution. An illustration, not a real fee: on a Rs 6 lakh budget, a tenth is Rs 60,000, and the rest can fund a laptop, tools, a few months of living cost while you build proof, and one targeted course.
